title: Auction policy
description: Private reserve status and fixed auction deadlines.
emptyBody: A published auction’s current rules will appear here.
unavailable: Current rules or historical results are unavailable. No change is confirmed.
reserve: Reserve set — a below-reserve close creates no sale.
reserveMet: Private reserve status: public price meets reserve.
reserveNotMet: Private reserve status: public price does not meet reserve.
fixedEnd: The scheduled end never extends, including after a late bid.
boundary: Server time is authoritative. At the exact deadline bidding is closed; your countdown cannot admit a late bid.
excluded: Auctions do not offer Buy Now. Fixed-price listings are unaffected.
held: Auction held or closed by its current commitment. Bidding is unavailable.
endedReview: Ended at the scheduled time — legacy purchase outcome under review. Financial commitments remain held.
signedout: Sign in as the seller to view private reserve status.
pending: Historical outcome pending. The original operation remains under review; no new purchase is made.
reserved: Historical reservation recorded. This is not payment confirmation.
reservation_denied: Historical reservation refused. Any financial hold needs Orders reconciliation.
cancelLink: Manage listing — request cancellation with no bids
